name: kitegtm
description: Ask about your Kite missions, buyer fits, conversations, campaigns, opportunities and Introductions across email, LinkedIn and SMS, and act on them from Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Kite is an introductions platform. Tell Kite what you want to achieve. Kite identifies the right people and gets you introduced. This plugin lets you ask about that work and act on it: see which missions need attention, read conversations and draft replies, review buyer fits, opportunities and which of them are Introductions, check campaigns, import contacts and add them to campaigns, pause or resume a mission or campaign, and record what came of an opportunity. Replies are saved as drafts that you send from KiteGTM. Billing, plans and Monthly Reach stay in KiteGTM.
capabilities: Read missions, buyer fits, conversations, campaigns, opportunities and Introductions
Draft a reply that you send from KiteGTM
Pause, resume or stop a mission, a campaign or a person
Import contacts and add them to a campaign
defaultPrompt: Which of my KiteGTM missions need attention?
Show me this week's new Introductions
Who replied today, and which replies need me?
